description: Checks a table spec, a BroTableSpec (get_docs, topic spec), and reports every error and warning with its path, what is wrong and the fix. Use it while you draft a spec. generate_code runs the same check first and returns the same report for a spec with errors. Example: {"spec": {"specVersion": 1, "rowType": "Product", "fields": [{"name": "title", "type": "string"}], "cols": [{"title": "Product", "name": "title"}]}, "skin": "mat"}

skin.description: The skin of the project: mat, bs or nv. Without it the spec is checked against all three

spec.description: A Table, Bro table as data: columns, custom cells, filters, rows, config and CSS variables, without functions and without the tags of a skin

api.description: The GET endpoint that gives the rows

filters.description: An API that gives pages: the query parameter of every key of the filters, as {"newsSite": "news_site"}; a range has the keys <name>From and <name>To

paging.description: An API that gives the rows page by page: the query parameters of the size of a page and of its offset or number

rows.description: The path of the array of the rows in the answer, as products; empty for an answer that is the array

search.description: An API that gives pages: the query parameter of its text search, as search

sort.description: An API that gives pages: the query parameters of the sort, of the field and of the direction, asc or desc; without order a minus before the field sorts down

total.description: The path of the number of all rows in the answer of a page, as total: an API that gives pages has it

url.description: The address of the endpoint, http or https

cells.description: The contracts of the custom cells and of the row details

actions.description: The actions the cell sends, as edit

fields.description: The fields of the row the cell reads

kind.description: A cell of a column, or the element of the row details

shows.description: What the cell shows, in words

component.description: A custom cell of cells, or a ready element of the skins: tags, switch or details-button

dataType.description: By default the type of the field

name.description: The field of the row the column shows

shortTitle.description: The title for the narrowest width of the column; the default is the first word of the title

sortKey.description: The field the column sorts by

rowDetailsComponent.description: A cell of the kind details

rowDetailsMotion.description: The motion of the row details: kinetic by default, eased opens them in --bro-details-duration

server.description: The rows come from the server by the query of the table

cssVars.description: The CSS variables of the table

--bro-column-width-duration.description: the duration of the motion of the columns to their new widths

--bro-corner-radius.description: the radius of the corners of the table; 0 keeps them square

--bro-details-duration.description: the duration of opening the row details

--bro-details-easing.description: the curve of the eased row details, with config.rowDetailsMotion: eased, and of the turn of their button

--bro-filter-drawer-corner-radius.description: the radius of the corners of the Filter Drawer; 0 keeps them square

--bro-filter-drawer-duration.description: the duration of the motion of the Filter Drawer and of the columns with it

--bro-filter-drawer-width.description: the width of the Filter Drawer

--bro-island-space-size.description: the space between the table and the Filter Drawer

--bro-kinetic-time-constant.description: the time constant of the kinetic scroll

--bro-refresh-overlay-opacity.description: how much the cells of the body fade during a refresh, in the light theme

--bro-refresh-overlay-opacity-dark.description: how much the cells of the body fade during a refresh, in the dark theme

--bro-row-height.description: the height of a body row

--bro-shadow-size.description: the size of the shadow of the table and the room the Filter Drawer leaves for it

--bro-state-icon-duration.description: the duration of the animation of the state icon

--bro-state-message-duration.description: the duration of the animation of the state message

--bro-table-body-container-z-index.description: the layer of the body of the table

--bro-table-min-width.description: the narrowest table, as wide as its paginator in one line; the Filter Drawer lies over a table that would be narrower next to it

source.description: With an API: the path of the value in an item of its answer, as price or meta.createdAt

values.description: All values of a string field: the rows take only them, a select filter offers them

filters.description: The filters of the Filter Drawer next to the table

field.description: The field of the row the filter compares

match.description: text: contains or startsWith; select and checkbox: eq; range compares itself

name.description: The key in the object of the filters; a range has the keys <name>From and <name>To

rule.description: The rule of the match custom, in words

rowType.description: The name of the type of a row in PascalCase, as Order

rows.description: The rows of the spec: objects with the fields of the row

skinConfig.description: The settings of the components of one skin, with the names of BroConfig

does.description: What the function does, in words

path.description: The path of the function, as components.sortHeader.afterRender

does.description: What the function does, in words

path.description: The path of the function, as components.sortHeader.afterRender

does.description: What the function does, in words

action.description: The action of the bro-action event on a click, as export

icon.description: The name of a Material icon, as download: in the mat skin a button of the toolbar is an icon with a tooltip, the other skins show the title
